name: Staged: conversation group facing the window, console behind the sofa on the open side, the right side a play wall
notes:
Staged pick. No TV (F-65); the bottom side is open to the kitchen and dining area, so its 30-inch walkway (y 143-173) stays clear (F-42): nothing stands against it or hangs on it, and it is the route from the stairs to the kitchen and dining room.
The KIVIK floats with its back to the open side and faces the window, with the LACK console behind it as the drop zone for keys and mail; a POÄNG at the coffee table's left end makes an L, and the window wall stays open as the view and a 38" route from the top landing to the play corner. The group sits toward the stairs, on the strip the drawn stair band used to keep clear, so the play floor between the sofa and the toy wall is 74" wide (38" before). The right side is Maddie's play wall (F-61): the SMÅSTAD reading bench in the window corner, a TROFAST below it, a low BESTÅ toy cabinet with her FLISAT book display in the 50" left of the open side's walkway, and the LEN play rug and the LÄTT table in the open floor.
sofa-1 KIVIK, rot 180, x 80.125-169.875, y 85-122.375, facing the window with two thirds of its length in front of the glass (the window's place is eyeballed): its front 79" from the heater face (F-33, 12" needed); the console and then the 30" open-side walkway behind it (F-39: 35.3" behind the console); delivery-path-unmeasured (F-22).
console-1 LACK console, x 97.438-152.562, y 122.375-137.75, against the sofa's back, facing the dining side: lamp-2 STORSEGEL on top, three GNABBAS baskets on its shelf; 5.3" short of the walkway (F-42).
coffee-table-1 LACK, x 107.312-142.688, y 47.375-69: 16" in front of the sofa (F-39); 41.4" between it and the heater face, the route along the window (F-30).
chair-1 POÄNG facing east at the coffee table's left end, x 59.062-91.312, y 44.812-71.562: 16" from the coffee table, 38.8" from the heater face (F-33); floor-lamp-2 TÅGARP behind its left shoulder (x 49.5-58.5, y 46-55) for reading, 13.5" off the walkway along the stairs.
side-table-1 LACK side table with lamp-1 STORSEGEL at the sofa's left arm, x 58.5-80.125, y 92-113.625, 22.5" past the walkway along the stairs.
rug-1 TIOKRONA turned 90 degrees, 94 x 118", x 76-170, y 24-142: under the sofa, the console, the coffee table and the POÄNG's front legs; plant-1 FEJKA at the console's left end (x 86-95, y 126-135).
toy-bench-1 SMÅSTAD, right-upper wall x 240.5-261, y 18-53.375: the reading seat in the window corner, 12" from the heater face (F-33: a cushion needs 12"); its boxes keep 24" clear in front (F-32). wall-lamp-1 UPPLYST above it and the LÖVA canopy over it (an extra). Check the heater's surface temperature before she reads there.
toy-storage-1 TROFAST, right-upper wall x 243.625-261, y 56.375-93: bins at her height, 24" clear in front (F-32); 20 1/2" tall, no anchoring needed.
toy-cabinet-1 BESTÅ shelf unit with doors 47 1/4 x 16 1/2 x 15", standing on the floor against the right-lower wall, x 259-275.5, y 94.75-142 (F-63): solid Lappviken push-open doors at her height, no glass, 15" tall (no anchoring needed, 44 lb per surface on the floor); 24" clear in front (F-32); it ends 1" short of the open side's walkway (F-42). book-display-1 FLISAT stands on it (top layer) with her picture books; art-1 PJÄTTERYD Waterlilies on the wall above.
rug-3 LEN play rug 52 x 63", x 178-230, y 60-123; kids-table-1 LÄTT with its two chairs, x 192-216.75, y 96-114.875: 2.9" outside the TROFAST's 24" (F-32), its upper chair clear of the SMÅSTAD's 24", its lower chair 17" above the walkway (F-42), 22" from the sofa's right arm. art-2 RÖDALM on the window wall over the reading corner.
Right side (F-61): the right-lower wall carries the BESTÅ (47 1/4" of the 50" left of the walkway), the 93" right-upper wall the SMÅSTAD and the TROFAST.
Not placed: the TV and every TV unit (F-65); the 70 7/8" BESTÅ drawer combination (on the right-lower wall it would reach 24" into the open side's walkway, and the stair side is kept as the walkway along the stairs); the BISSA shoe cabinet, hooks and PERJOHAN bench (the bottom wall they stood on is open); the chaise sofa and the KALLAX units (c, d); the KIVIK ottoman and STOENSE rug (d); the VALLABY rug (c); the kid's POÄNG (c, d); the LAUTERS (e).
Stairs: they run outside the left wall, beyond the measured 261" (F-40; Andrew, 2026-10-24: the stairs add to the room, they are not cut from it), so the floor is whole up to that wall. Both 36" landings at the ends of the stairs (x 0-36, y 0-36 and y 137-173) stay clear, and the 36" strip along the stairs between them (x 0-36) is the walkway that joins them: the bottom landing opens onto the open side's walkway, the top one onto the strip and the route along the window (F-30). Nothing stands against the stair side, whose edge (wall, half wall or railing) is unknown, so Maddie has nothing there to climb (F-21); which end people step off is unknown too (assumed-position:stairs).
Heater: every clearance is measured from the drawn 6" heater face (heater-depth-assumed): floor pieces start at y 12 or more and upholstery at y 18 or more (F-33). Window: its place on the top wall is eyeballed (assumed-position:window); curtains and rod hang there and nothing stands under it (F-38).
Entry: the old shoe cabinet, hooks and mirror hung on the bottom wall, which is open; the hooks are gone, and the LILJETRÄD mirror hangs on the window wall above the top landing.
Kid safety (F-21): no glass anywhere; storage over 27" is anchored.
Extras: GINSTMOTT curtains x2 pairs, HUGAD rod x1 (no-dimensions, an extra), SVARTPOPPEL covers x2, VALLKRASSING covers x2, FJÄDRAR inserts x4, VALLKRASSING throw x1, GNABBAS baskets x3 (console shelf), LÖVA canopy x1.
